missing: Independently measured usable capacity and real camping runtimes (phone charges, nights of CPAP, 12V cooler hours) plus car and solar recharge times in the field, and a reconciliation of the conflicting model names and prices (Explorer 300 vs 300 Plus vs 300 v2, $279–$299) across the sources.
why: Only one major reviewer (Yahoo Tech) answers, and it covers the under-$250 tier rather than the full under-$300 field; the rest are niche spec comparisons and affiliate listicles that broadly agree on the Bluetti Elite 30 V2, EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus, Anker C300 and Jackery 300 Plus but mostly recycle manufacturer specs rather than test.
